name: Life spaceship a07330dc on 3-uniform tiling k3-011
description: A period-4 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-011, with touching neighbours, 11 to 18 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 8,192 rules from B3/S23 to B3,6,8,9,10,11,12/S2,3,9,10,11,12. JETCARP's Life census met it in one of its 50,000 soups on this tiling. It contains a perturbed phase of the smaller ship 28714e5c1bb83bd3, 6573d1df1e7da7c8.
